groups.title: Main navigation
groups.intro: Five persistent destinations: Übersicht, Flüge, Flugbuch, Verein and AI. Selected outlined icons/labels use teal #27d3d2; inactive labels use #a9bed3. A raised selected tab surface and accessible selected state carry meaning too. Legacy duotone asset paths are retained. Retained textual cues include ↗, ●, ×, ↑, ↓, ↔ and Δ in their status/detail contexts.

entries.title: Medical overview tile

Missing/ambiguous/partial source explicit; raw text retained. No fitness or legal eligibility judgment. No fitness verdict follows from icon color.

entries.title: Synchronize data / Sync
entries.appearance: Outlined refresh at 24 dp, independent session mark and Sync/Lädt caption. The circular face is 44 dp wide and at least 38 dp high inside a target of at least 48 dp. A conditional status row below the toolbar exposes saved age/details; the accessible button label retains age and state.
entries.where: Ordinary app header; separate from provider-panel session indicators.
entries.meaning: One complete guarded synchronization action. Saved successful flight receipt age, recent session proof and synchronization recommendation have independent cues; none establishes complete source coverage.
entries.behavior: The header is the only entry to provider update/login. Tap opens the whole update journey in a retained centered popup frame; original login appears only if needed. Other pages provide passive guidance. Contextual return is preserved.
entries.states: Green ✓ requires matching confirmed proof younger than 90 seconds. During checking only identical previous owner/store scope, account, club and last-check timestamp may retain display within 90 seconds; canonical authentication stays unchanged. → means login required; ? unknown/checking without retained proof; ! mismatch/error. Saved age stays neutral through login/error except a steady amber border/surface and age ! strictly after 72 hours, regardless of session; exactly 72 hours stays quiet. Login/checks/failure/cancellation never renew receipt age. Scoped changed-count activity advice may independently recommend sync. It is foreground-only, hourly at most, and cannot advance saved receipt age.

entries.title: Last confirmed session check
entries.appearance: Compact Cockpit outlined symbol from the maintained SVG master and generated native RGBA palettes. Its labelled parent retains action and state semantics.
entries.where: Provider connection panel. Its original chain/spinner presentation remains separate from S01 header session marks and saved-flight age.
entries.meaning: A previous session check matched the provisional account association.
entries.behavior: Open details to read the last-check time and available next action.
entries.states: Requires observed + confirmed + observed identity + lastCheckedAt. No automatic expiry threshold is implemented; a tick does not promise continuous login or fresh imported flights.

entries.title: Provider login required
entries.appearance: Compact Cockpit outlined symbol from the maintained SVG master and generated native RGBA palettes. Its labelled parent retains action and state semantics.
entries.where: Provider connection panel. Its original chain/spinner presentation remains separate from S01 header session marks and saved-flight age.
entries.meaning: Login on the original Vereinsflieger page is required.
entries.behavior: The ordinary header Daten action opens the complete synchronization journey, showing original-provider login when needed. The panel badge does not submit credentials.
entries.states: Login-required state. Keep distinct from the same arrow used for route direction or forward navigation.

entries.title: Connection attention / blocked
entries.appearance: Compact Cockpit outlined symbol from the maintained SVG master and generated native RGBA palettes. Its labelled parent retains action and state semantics.
entries.where: Provider connection panel. Its original chain/spinner presentation remains separate from S01 header session marks and saved-flight age.
entries.meaning: Something needs review: account/club mismatch, failed checking, association confirmation, or recovery blocking retrieval.
entries.behavior: Open details to understand the specific reason and next action.
entries.states: Recovery forces the ! badge. Several causes share the shape, so accompanying accessible wording/details must distinguish them. A session error does not prove logout.

entries.title: Busy / checking / saving
entries.appearance: Native ActivityIndicator: indeterminate spinner. The sample here is a schematic still.
entries.where: Provider connection panel. Its original chain/spinner presentation remains separate from S01 header session marks and saved-flight age.
entries.meaning: Work is in progress; the result is not known yet.
entries.behavior: No separate action on the spinner. The containing control and explicit operation buttons define available actions.
entries.states: Connection pending covers clearing, binding, busy retrieval/restoring/saving, login attempt, disconnect checking and session checking. Local/profile spinners mean their own named operation. This is not percentage progress.

entries.states: Unknown time is —; known zero remains 0:00. Partly unknown durations have a separate notice. Unassigned dates prevent a confirmed empty season even with retrieval coverage. Saved periods need not be complete/comparable; enlarged metrics scroll horizontally.

groups.title: Actions and navigation cues
groups.intro: Several repeated characters have different meanings by context. Redesign each semantic role, while keeping related navigation controls visually consistent.

groups.title: Data notation and visual state markers
groups.intro: These are part of the symbol language too, even where replacing them with pictograms would be unnecessary.

entries.title: Unknown / unavailable value
entries.appearance: — (U+2014): em dash in a value field.
entries.where: Missing places/times, distance/weather placeholders and unavailable summaries.
entries.meaning: The value is not available in that context.
entries.behavior: Read-only notation. Explanatory text supplies the reason where known.
entries.states: Never turn unknown into zero, a negative result or an invented measurement. An actually known numeric zero keeps its own meaning.
entries.locator: weather/latest/club placeholders; MobileApp metrics and fields

entries.title: Average per flight
entries.appearance: Ø (U+00D8) in Ø pro Flug.
entries.where: Flüge summary strip.
entries.meaning: Average flight duration.
entries.behavior: Read-only statistic label; calculations remain deterministic.
entries.states: A missing duration makes the overall average incomplete; the existing missing-time notice must remain clear.

entries.title: Recorded pilot-role badge
entries.appearance: Rounded text pill, commonly Schulung or a recorded role such as PIC/FI.
entries.where: Flight row beside duration.
entries.meaning: The saved role for this flight; Dual is displayed as Schulung.
entries.behavior: Read-only badge inside the row; the surrounding row opens details.
entries.states: Rendered only when a role exists. A role badge is not an inferred qualification or permission.

entries.title: Selected scope / tab / chip
entries.appearance: Blue filled chip and/or cyan selected navigation label/icon.
entries.where: Year, training and club-section chips; main tabs.
entries.meaning: Which query scope or destination is active.
entries.behavior: Tap changes the named scope or destination.
entries.states: Selection must remain available through text and accessibility state. It does not mean successful synchronization or completed work.

entries.title: Inline separator
entries.appearance: · (U+00B7): middle dot.
entries.where: Aircraft metadata, source status and multi-part descriptions.
entries.meaning: Separates adjacent pieces of text.
entries.behavior: No action.
entries.states: Typographic separator, not an unread notification dot or status light.

entries.title: Prompt / working-text ellipsis
entries.appearance: … (U+2026): ellipsis.
entries.where: Search/AI prompts and working messages.
entries.meaning: A continuing text prompt or in-progress operation, depending on wording.
entries.behavior: No independent overflow-menu action.
entries.states: It is not a three-dot options button. Busy operations use explicit text/spinner S05.

entries.title: Negative sign / signed value
entries.appearance: − (U+2212): mathematical minus sign.
entries.where: Season comparison deltas and relative saved-flight date ages.
entries.meaning: A negative change from the comparison value, or elapsed time before the present, as stated by its label.
entries.behavior: Read-only numeric/date notation; no independent action.
entries.states: Keep distinct from T01's em dash for an unknown or unavailable value and from a hyphen used in prose.
